attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a shared writable directory with the sticky bit (mode 1777, owned root:root), so any user can create files but only the file owner (or root) can remove/rename them. Verified with two test users: cross-user delete is rejected (Operation not permitted) while own-file delete succeeds and other-user creation succeeds. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1 via sudo reboot, polled through the outage until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified /srv/drop's permissions, sticky-bit deny-delete behavior, and pre-existing file data all survived the restart.
